acceptance_rule: Accept iff: (a) a never-claimed proposed promotion-lane ticket closes as rejected + realized_failure_mode=duplicate_reservation_accounting without a claim receipt; (b) every other closeout path still hard-requires the receipt (claimed ticket, wrong failure mode, accepted/observed_only override, substantive rejected close on claimed tickets); (c) boundary smoke: unknown id, terminal-immutability retry, non-promotion lane unchanged; (d) the two deadlocked tickets exp-20260804-002 and exp-20260814-001 close cleanly and leave list_experiments with no stale open duplicates of today's alpha bundle.

hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: Never-claimed promotion-lane experiment reservations are deadlocked by the claim-receipt closeout guard: a reservation whose claim fails during claim-receipt construction (for example the receipt CAS per-file size cap) can neither be claimed nor closed, because every closeout path requires an alpha_promotion_claim_receipt that only a successful claim can produce. Second occurrence (exp-20260804-002 documented backlog, exp-20260814-001 today). Repair: permit closing a ticket that was never claimed (claimed_at null, no claim receipt, status proposed) only as non-substantive duplicate_reservation_accounting bookkeeping with a rejected-flavored terminal status, keeping every substantive closeout receipt-gated.

in_flight_duplicate_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §7 并发重复 reserve: the novelty gate cannot see in-flight tickets, so reservation re-checks open proposed/claimed/running tickets from the last 7 days and blocks fingerprint near-duplicates (score >= 0.65). Coordinate via scripts/list_experiments.py and scripts/agent_mailbox.py instead of racing.

nearest.reopen_condition: Follow exp-20260712-002's closeout boundary; this ticket added no evidence.
A reproducible new lane-scope or receipt-integrity bypass not covered by the centralized promotion-required-lane predicate.
Revisit only if a concrete leakage, tamper, revocation, or PIT-authority failure escapes the deterministic promotion checks, or a new promotion schema needs additional hash-bound evidence.
The underlying alpha may reopen only at the recorded strict settlement and active-reduction power bars with a fresh verified promotion.
Reopen only with a reproducible post-cutoff bypass, a new runtime/provider trust primitive, or a changed experiment lifecycle that is not covered by the shared promotion validator.

observed_only_streak_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 forward-row attribution: after 3 consecutive observed-only closes on one data_source population, a further observed-only probe needs materially more settled rows, a new data source, or a new gate shape.

recipe_lane_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 排名/枚举清单消费: consuming a ranked list or finite taxonomy with one fixed evaluation recipe, one item per ID, is loop unrolling — not new evidence. After the lane triggers, only a single pooled batch (once) or park is legal. Curated lanes: docs/recipe_lanes.jsonl.

reopen_condition_guard.rule: If a parked surface has a quantitative reopen_condition, alpha-lane reservations that target that surface are blocked until the numeric reopen checks pass, unless the ticket names a genuinely new data source or a new gate shape.

routine_materialization_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 routine delta materialization: after 3 routine forward-ledger materialization IDs (one concrete surface, or same-shape across surfaces within 7 days), wire the materialization into run.py / the settlement pipeline once instead of reserving further manual IDs. Fault recovery is exempt.

saturated_source_axis.rule: For saturated (gate_shape, data_source) cells, legal override axes are limited to a new data source, a new gate shape, or materially more closed/settled forward rows. Same-source new fields/tags do not qualify.

prediction.confidence_reason: Deterministic tooling defect with reproducible deadlock; narrow predicate keeps the anti-bypass property; risk is mostly in status-string conventions consumed by audit/family builders.

calibration.surprise_note: Deterministic tooling defect; repair behaved as predicted on both live deadlocked tickets.
